MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_LIGHT_POWER.title: Light
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_LIGHT_POWER.descri: [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold]' Light. [gold]Draw-cut[/gold] cards consume all of it for damage that ignores Block. It all fades if you end your turn holding another sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_LIGHT_POWER.smartD: {Amount} Light. [gold]Draw-cut[/gold] cards consume all of it for damage that ignores Block. It all fades if you end your turn holding a sword other than [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_FOUR_TREASURES_POW: When you end your turn with [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] current, charge more [gold]Light[/gold]. From level 3, also gain [gold]Block[/gold].
When you end your turn with [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] current, charge {Amount} more [gold]Light[/gold]. From level 3, also gain [gold]Block[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_SILVER_ARM_POWER.d: When [gold]Light[/gold] fades as a cost, gain [gold]Block[/gold] per Light. Whenever you [gold]Draw-cut[/gold], draw cards.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SOLAIS_SILVER_ARM_POWER.s: When [gold]Light[/gold] fades as a cost, gain 4 (5 from level 3) x{Amount} [gold]Block[/gold] per Light. Whenever you [gold]Draw-cut[/gold], draw 2 x{Amount} cards.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_LETHE_POWER.des: This turn, your next single-target attack hits up to 3 enemies whatever your current sword is, with no damage reduction against a lone enemy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_LETHE_POWER.sma: This turn, your next {Amount} single-target attack(s) hit up to 3 enemies whatever your current sword is, with no damage reduction against a lone enemy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_GROWING_BLADE_P: Whenever one of your attacks hits 2 or more enemies, gain [gold]Block[/gold].
Whenever one of your attacks hits 2 or more enemies, gain {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold].
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CALADBOLG_ULSTER_HERO_POW: [gold]Caladbolg[/gold]'s effect hits ALL enemies. Its damage reduction against a lone enemy is halved.
[gold]Caladbolg[/gold]'s effect hits ALL enemies. Its damage reduction against a lone enemy is halved.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-UNSTRUCK_KINGS_SHIELD_POW: Gains [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of its next turn.
Gains {Amount} [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of its next turn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CURRENT_SWORD_POWER.CLAIO: End your turn holding this sword to charge 1 [gold]Light[/gold]. End your turn holding another sword and all Light fades.
End your turn holding this sword to charge 1 [gold]Light[/gold]. End your turn holding another sword and all Light fades. (Level {Level}: more [gold]Draw-cut[/gold] damage per Light.)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-CURRENT_SWORD_POWER.CALAD: Attacks that target one enemy also hit up to 2 other random enemies for the same damage. Attacks deal less damage when there is only one enemy.
Attacks that target one enemy also hit up to 2 other random enemies for the same damage. Attacks deal less damage when there is only one enemy (level {Level}: 30% less, 3% less reduction per level).
